voice.name: Open Sector - Vanguard
voice.description: Scrappy male assault gun crewman in his late twenties, quick wiry mid-range voice with a cheeky streetwise accent, practical and blunt, a bit sarcastic, talks fast like a mechanic who fixes things with a hammer, shouting over engine noise on a tank radio.
voice.sample: Vanguard here, low and mean. No turret, no problem, we just point the whole tank at it. Keep them in front of us and we'll knock them flat. Just don't let anybody sneak round the side, alright?

fire.prompt: Distant, powerful boom of a modern assault gun firing its main cannon in an open field, the blast rolling and echoing off the hills.

move.prompt: Modern armored vehicle diesel engine revving and steel tracks pivoting on dirt, squealing turn and clanking, short one-shot, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Armored vehicle hit and exploding, sharp metal blast and burning wreck crackle with debris, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice
